honest+uniting: bringing us together, authentically
performed+dividing: exploiting our divisions, deliberately
honest+dividing: fracturing us, truthfully

{"type":"list_examples"}
{"type":"inspect_example","id":<integer reference ID>}
{"type":"submit_prediction","prediction":{"performed+uniting":<probability>,"honest+uniting":<probability>,"performed+dividing":<probability>,"honest+dividing":<probability>}}

No target label or reward is available.

A shared topic, category, or association alone is not enough to transfer both judgments. A divisive response does not by itself establish whether that division is performed or honest. Use an example only for the judgments it supports; discount it or ignore it when transfer is weak. Keep the final four-quadrant prediction joint: do not assume the two axes are statistically independent.
